title: [MCP] Allow setting default configuration from card
summary: The MCP configuration card now provides actions to set and clear default configurations directly from the card interface, with new regression tests added.
key_points: Added Set as Default and Clear Default actions to MCP Config Card
Added regression test cases for setting and clearing default configuration
Improves usability by allowing default management from the card
